name: Kagami no Naka no Orgel - Mittsume no Monogatari [Haensel und Gretel]
original_name: 鏡の中のオルゴール　みっつめの物語 [Haensel und Gretel]
source:
Handel and Gretel are abandoned by their mothers due to food starvation. After several days of travelling in the forest they find a funny house to rest inside. As Haensel wakes up, he sees Gretel captured by the witch. What if Haensel was not able to save Gretel as in original? Here is how it might look if both got captured...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
汉塞尔与格蕾特因为食物短缺而被母亲遗弃。在森林中跋涉数日后，他们发现一间古怪的小屋，便进去休息。汉塞尔醒来时，看到格蕾特已经落入魔女手中。倘若汉塞尔未能像原作中那样救出格蕾特，故事又会如何？这便是兄妹二人双双被擒后的可能结局……
